effect_description_eng: [On Play] Trash 1 card in your hand. Then, you may return 1 Digimon card with the [Evil], [Dark Dragon] or [Evil Dragon] trait from your trash to the hand.
inherited_effect_description_eng: ＜Retaliation＞ (When this Digimon is deleted after losing a battle, delete the Digimon it was battling.)
